subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require an exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream fixture before accepting any recovery that can reclassify assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The safe fix shape depends on maintainer appetite for provider-specific recovery at the tool-execution boundary versus waiting for an exact stream fixture; source inspection alone cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor narrow vLLM recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned recovery design for this provider/model family with false-promotion tests and security review.

options.title: Treat docs workaround as enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide vLLM parser/template or tool_choice configuration fully covers this deployment class despite the structured-wire evidence.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work is closest to the OpenAI-compatible reasoning/tool-call parsing boundary and vLLM wrapper surface.
